CAVEAT: this characterises dispersion around the central estimate. The registered MARGIN_SD 13.97 remains a COHERENCE TOLERANCE and is not a cover law; using it as a distributional constant is a category error regardless of this measurement.
COMPARISON_WITH_CFB: CFB retains 10,818 out-of-fold residuals, so its SD is measured (16.716) and a per-week schedule is fittable. WNBA retained none until now. The asymmetry was never a property of the sport; it was a property of what each pipeline chose to keep.
WHY_THIS_RECORD_EXISTS: wnba_model_v1.walk_forward() materialises per-game m_pred and m_act; evaluate() collapses them to a single MAE and discards the rest. So the SD was always computable and was never retained. An external verifier re-ran this same walk-forward, obtained n=1721 and MAE 9.881 identical to this record, and still reported sigma as MAE*sqrt(pi/2)=12.384 — the residuals were in memory at that moment. That is the third instance in this system of a value computed, returned and thrown away, after sp_asof_strict's last_start_date and the inert information dose, and it happened inside an audit whose stated purpose was finding exactly that class.
